decision: Acquire one permitted global historical scheduled-route reference; do not invent tiers while access is unresolved.
preferred_candidates: Cirium historical/global schedules under an evaluation, academic, or contracted license whose scope explicitly permits the required research use
OAG historical/global schedules under an academic or contracted license whose scope explicitly permits the required research use
reference_window_rule: single 12-month window ending no more than 30 days before final frame freeze
must_supply: global coverage adequate for the six-region frame
scheduled route origin/destination records for network degree

not_sufficient_alone.OurAirports: airport metadata but no binding 12-month traffic/schedule reference
not_sufficient_alone.FAA_BTS: useful U.S. reference but not a global six-region reference
not_sufficient_alone.OpenSky: valuable university-accessible observed ADS-B traffic, but by itself does not supply the binding scheduled-route reference required for §4.5 degree/carrier/international variables

current_tier_policy: Until a permitted reference is actually obtained and frozen, TRAFFIC_REFERENCE=BLOCKED; airports without verified traffic remain UNCLASSIFIED and final sampling-frame rebuild cannot PASS.
